links.outcome: External validation AUC at a new site versus original validation, pretrained models unmodified
links.effect: AUCs at SSHC were 0.67 (HIV), 0.70 (syphilis), 0.73 (gonorrhoea), 0.65 (chlamydia), lower than original MSHC validation metrics (0.74-0.87, all p<0.001).
links.quote: The area under the receiver operating characteristic curve (AUC) values using data from SSHC were 0.67 (95% CI: 0.65–0.68) for HIV, 0.70 (95% CI: 0.69–0.71) for syphilis, 0.73 (95% CI: 0.73–0.74) for gonorrhoea, and 0.65 (95% CI: 0.65–0.66) for chlamydia, which were lower than the original MSHC validation metrics (0.74–0.87, all p < 0.001).

links.outcome: Model performance across demographic subgroups (MSM, age)
links.effect: Performance varied across subgroups: HIV AUC 0.78 among men who have sex with men; gonorrhoea AUC 0.79 among attendees <25 years.
links.quote: Notably, model performance varied across demographic subgroups, with stronger HIV prediction among men who have sex with men with an AUC of 0.78 and better gonorrhoea prediction among younger attendees < 25 years with an AUC value of 0.79.

screen.reason: The study conducts an external validation of an existing predictive risk model (MySTIRisk) on retrospective EHR data from a second sexual health center, evaluating generalizability and subgroup disparities.
